book.title: Five-Ingredient Weeknights
book.subtitle: Short lists, proper dinners
book.description: Four straightforward meals whose core shopping list stays deliberately short. Oil, salt and pepper are treated as staples.

recipes.title: Lemon Chickpea Couscous
recipes.description: Fluffy couscous, chickpeas and spinach with a sharp lemon dressing.
instructions: Cover the couscous with 300 ml boiling water, cover and rest for 8 minutes.
Warm the drained chickpeas in a pan with half the lemon juice.
Fluff the couscous, then fold through chickpeas and spinach until the leaves soften.
Add the remaining lemon, herbs and seasoning.
recipes.rights_notes: Original Kitchen Companion draft; test cook and nutrition review required.

recipes.title: Smoky Black Bean Tacos
recipes.description: Crisp tortillas filled with smoky beans, sweetcorn and avocado.
instructions: Drain the beans and cook them with the tomatoes and paprika for 10 minutes.
Mash a third of the beans to thicken the filling.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with beans, sweetcorn and sliced avocado.
recipes.rights_notes: Original Kitchen Companion draft; test cook and nutrition review required.

recipes.title: Tomato Butter Bean Orzo
recipes.description: A creamy one-pan orzo made without dairy.
instructions: Put the orzo, tomatoes, 600 ml water and crumbled stock cube in a wide pan.
Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring often so the pasta does not stick.
Add the drained beans and cook for 5 minutes until the orzo is tender.
Fold in spinach, season and rest for 2 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Coconut Red Lentil Dal
recipes.description: A gentle, creamy dal built from cupboard staples.
instructions: Rinse the lentils until the water runs mostly clear.
Put lentils, tomatoes, coconut milk, curry powder and 300 ml water in a pan.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 22 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season and add a little water if the dal is thicker than you like.
